Sleep spindles and overnight retention across the lifespan

Results. Spindle density showed a modest positive correlation with overnight retention in adults aged 20 to 35 (r = 0.21). In children under 12 we found no association between spindle density and overnight retention. Among adolescents the correlation was weak and did not survive correction for multiple comparisons.

Discussion. The relationship between spindles and memory consolidation appears to depend strongly on age and should not be assumed to hold in every age group.
